Primary signature minimum height 28px. Compact mark minimum 16px, with a simplified one-color favicon at 16px. Clear space: at least one quarter of the mark height on all sides. Do not distort, recolor to status green, merge with social logos, add a seal or put small text inside the mark. Reverse on ink; primary on cream/white. The generated concept wordmark is recreated as licensed Source Serif 4 outlines, not live-font text. SVGs are editable geometry, but outlined brand lettering must not be retyped casually.
